ideas.pitch: An AI-powered real-time transit and ride-pooling dispatcher specifically built for Stony Brook University's campus loops and local student transit needs.
ideas.title: CampusShuttle-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a problem the judges feel themselves by addressing daily transportation friction around the Stony Brook campus.

ideas.pitch: An automated energy and resource consumption forecasting dashboard for university dormitories using lightweight regression models to predict peak utility loads.
ideas.title: DormAudit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the pattern of clear measurable impact by offering concrete economic and environmental benefits for university facilities management.

ideas.pitch: An AI nutrition assistant tailored to on-campus dining hall menus, helping students balance meals based on real-time daily ingredients and personal dietary restrictions.
ideas.title: SBU-Dining-Nutrition-Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets an immediate, relatable pain point for college students living on campus who navigate dining hall options daily.

ideas.pitch: An automated computer vision and audio pipeline that indexes rapid-fire university lecture recordings into searchable, structured revision knowledge graphs.
ideas.title: LectureLens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies technically challenging graph intelligence and NLP workflows to a domain that both students and academic judges intimately understand.

ideas.pitch: A transparent decentralized treasury and reimbursement tracking platform for student organizations to manage event funding securely.
ideas.title: ClubBudget-Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets student club leaders and treasurers dealing with sluggish university bureaucracy for event funding reimbursements.
